rationale: The assistant reached the correct cause (snapped door catch holding the microswitch open) by the third turn, grounded it in the customer's own evidence ('runs while held, stops when released'), and gave the right safety line: unplug, don't use, 'do not tape, wedge or bypass the door switch'. The part direction (door handle/catch assembly, model number required, no compatibility claim) matches the expected answer. Weaknesses: turn 2 put turning the drum by hand ahead of the simpler door-latch check and over-escalated the interlock to an engineer, and turns 4-6 recycled the same model-number request, receiving-slot check and panel three times while the customer was simply going to read the label, which is redundant though not blocking.
